name: Heightmap Combination & Seamless Terrain Generation
aliases: Seamless Terrain Generation via Heightmap Stitching
definition: Combines multiple heightmaps into a single RGB(A) image to optimize texture reads, then stitches random areas using simplex noise to generate macroscopic terrain, recursively sampling for finer details down to the voxel level.
summary: Heightmap Combination stitches multiple pre-existing heightmaps into a seamless terrain using simplex noise, optimizing memory by packing sources into a single texture.
